meta.name: mnemehq-site-repo
meta.description: Canonical repository memory for the Mneme HQ website and publishing repository.

items.title: Branch names describe the work, not the execution model
items.content: Use distinctive, intent-based branch names under the repository taxonomy (for example site/, feat/, fix/, ci/, docs/, or refactor/). Do not include the model, assistant, coding harness, or tool identity in a branch name, including codex/, chatgpt/, claude/, copilot/, or generic agent prefixes, unless that named product is genuinely the subject of the repository change. Normalize an automatically generated branch name before preparing a pull request. Example: site/insights-governance-wave-aug-2026.
